The '''sharing of water''' may refer to:

#The ancestors of the [[Cairhien]]in people allowing the [[Aiel]] to make wells and draw water from them in their territory. See [[Aiel#Water-sharing|notes on the original sharing of water]] under [[Aiel#Into the Waste]].
#The ritual of drinking water when meeting Aiel, leading to a relaxation of formality. See [[Aiel#Sharing of water]].
